scene: The brass meter prints transit passes for three waiting rides.
picture: A flat side view along a stone promenade. Far left, a green bicycle rickshaw sits parked. Left of centre, an elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap, orange cardigan, holding a wooden cane, stands beside an open brass meter. Up high, an overhead track holds a red monorail car. Far right, a wooden funicular car waits on slanted rails.
shown: a green bicycle rickshaw parked with an empty passenger bench on the far left
a sleek red monorail car idling at an open door up high
a wooden funicular carriage waiting on slanted rails on the far right
